category: multi-hoster (Polish; time accounts and transfer packs)

free_tier.stated: 250 MB free on registration to test the service; the registration page title also advertises a 3-day free test with no card.
free_tier.notes: Two free allowances, which do not contradict each other: a one-time 250 MB of transfer on registration (FAQ and terms chapter 4 item 6), and one file per day with no account (terms chapter 5 section 1 item 3). The daily file has no stated size cap, host list or behaviour at the limit; it is unverified how it is enforced.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-file cap is stated on the offer page or the FAQ

retention.stated: unverified: how long a transferred file stays downloadable is not stated; transfer packs carry no time limit

egress.terms: Time accounts: 50 GB/24h for 30 days at 18.2, or 100 GB/24h for 30 days at 35.99. Transfer packs: 50 GB at 17.99 up to 830 GB at 132.99, with no time limit.

interface_detail: Web form and account panel; the FAQ says a download manager such as JDownloader can be fed the links.
tooling: Browser or JDownloader; no API is documented on the pages read.
chaining: A transfer pack (volume, no expiry) covers irregular pulls; a time account covers a daily allowance. Hosts: 46 listed.

limits.value: time accounts 50 GB or 100 GB per 24 hours; transfer packs 50 GB to 830 GB with no time limit
unverified: no per-second or concurrency limit stated

binding_note: Both account types are metered in bytes: a daily allowance on time accounts and a fixed pack on transfer accounts.

identity_cost.detail: Registration form with a 12-character password rule and consent boxes; the page title states a 3-day free test with no card. The remaining form fields were not rendered, so an email field is unverified.

reliability_note: No outage or removal observed; the site shows live counters (users online, bandwidth load, total downloaded).
confidence_note: First-party pages read the same day: FAQ, price list, registration page. Currency read from the price list header (PLN).
